title: Second nested projection of a paired string
statement: For bit strings $x,U,t,u,j,p$, let $\langle a,b\rangle$ denote the encoding obtained by doubling each bit of $a$, appending the separator $01$, and then appending $b$. Applying the total second projection twice to $\langle\langle x,U\rangle,\langle\langle u,j\rangle,p\rangle\rangle$ returns $p$.
